text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rivals hone themselves day in and day 
out, each striving toward their own goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if everyone aims for different 
things, we all keep running under the same 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Marvelous Sunday puts her whole heart 
into running to spread the marvel. The 
Takarazuka Kinen begins now—!
